Hi Priya / Camila —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We reviewed the MAP internally and put together a slightly updated mutual action plan attached (Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx). We want to lock the final go/no-go and the signature timing this week so we can align our procurement and scheduling. Key asks from our side: 

- Confirm final exec signer windows (we have a 2-hour window on Tue/Wed mornings PT)
- Clarify exact start-date options (preferred: Mon 7/5 or Mon 7/12) and any ramp week requirements
- Confirm which SOW version you want us to sign (we attached the doc with our comments)

We can route the PO to procurement once legal confirms redlines. Can you confirm who on your side will own the final signoff and whether Redwood will accept staggered signer slots (we'd like an option to countersign within 48h)?

Sophie — thanks for the updated MAP and the clear asks. Summary from Redwood's side below so we have a single source of truth before legal/procurement kick off: 

1) Final signoff owners
   - Commercial signoff (pricing/PO): Priya Natarajan (me) / Finance ops (cc'd on PO routing)
   - Legal signoff (SOW redlines): Karthik Iyer (counsel)
   - Exec signoff (if >15% discount or non-standard SLA): Karthik will escalate to execs as needed

2) Signer windows
   - We can commit to Tue/Wed 9–11am PT and Wed 1–3pm PT windows for countersignature. If you need staggered signing (Acme signs first, Redwood countersigns within 48h) that is acceptable — please confirm which window you'd like reserved.

3) Start-date options and ramp
   - Preferred production start date options: Mon 2027-07-05 or Mon 2027-07-12.
   - We recommend a 2-day canary (10% traffic) followed by a phased ramp to 100% over 5 business days. Camila will handle run-of deployment.

4) SOW and redlines
   - Please send the annotated SOW back in PDF; we attached our working draft capturing material redlines (SOW_draft_redlines.pdf). Karthik, please prioritize review for the items flagged as security/data residency.

Attachment: SOW_draft_redlines.pdf (redline view, key comments inline)

Next steps: Sophie — confirm which signer window you want reserved and the preferred start date. Once Sophie confirms, Karthik will do a legal pass and we'll send the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan

Adding operational details from my side —

- Deployment windows: we can support 7/5 start with a team on standby for rollout; if you choose 7/12 we can schedule a wider launch (preferred for larger training windows). See deployment-window.csv attached for proposed blackout windows and SRE on-call coverage.
- Dedicated capacity booking: to guarantee the SLA during evaluation, we recommend reserving a Dedicated pool for the first 14 days (helps keep latency stable during ramp). If you'd prefer Hosted with autoscale, note that we cannot guarantee fixed throughput during your 10% canary.
- Model pinning: we will lock to model version rwd-open-12b-v2 for the eval period to avoid regression risk. Any change requires 48h notice.

Attachment: deployment-window.csv (availability grid + recommended on-call)

Small ask: Sophie, could you confirm acceptance criteria for the MAP's quality metrics column (precision/recall thresholds and acceptable failure modes) so we can instrument proper monitoring prior to day 0?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
